lines.text: Patient rings asking for a repeat of an anti-inflammatory for a long-standing shoulder problem.
They confirm the shoulder is no worse than usual and they are not asking to be seen.

at the end they mention in passing that they have been taking the same medication from a second source for a fortnight because the first prescription ran out, which turns a repeat request into a question about how much they have actually been taking
The medication list shows one active anti-inflammatory and no second supply.
